text: Irradiated is a buff granted to new gnome characters that choose the New Tinkertown starting zone. It gives off a "green" aura as they're exposed to radiation and are in danger of turning into a leper gnome. The buff cannot be canceled manually but will be removed during Decontamination, a quest during the New Tinkertown quest chain. It also automatically falls off upon leaving Gnomeregan, even if the quest is skipped.

Irresistible Red Button is crafted by Khaz Algar Engineering (80). It requires: * 10x Pile of Rusted Scrap (BoP) * 12x Handful of Bismuth Bolts * 3x Whimsical Wiring * 4x Gyrating Gear * 1x Entropy Enhancer Non-engineers who wish to acquire one for the Skull-Scythe Handlebars, part of the Felreaver Deathcycle from Horrific Visions Revisited, will need to make one via Crafting Orders. Public orders require the orderer to supply all parts, including the BoP Pile of Rusted Scrap. These piles can be found in limited supply on engineering vendors all over Azeroth. Using it summons Irresistible Red Button, which when pressed turns into a D.O.G.G.O..

Irradiated Verdant Seed has a chance to drop from Irradiated herbs throughout Khaz Algar. The player must have at least 20 Khaz Algar Herbalism Knowledge in the Cultivation (Herbalism) sub-specialization of the Botany specialization in order to receive the item. It can be planted at Beledar's Bounty of Hallowfall to grow into a random Irradiated Khaz Algar herb.

Irradiated herbs are variants of herbs found rarely throughout Khaz Algar. They can be gathered by players with the Herbalism skill and give both the herb and Leyline Residue. Gathering irradiated herbs causes the remaining stem to thrum with energy and knock the player away after a few seconds. This knockback only affects the player who gathered the herb, not other nearby players. Overloading the herb will replace the Overload spell with Arcane Duplication which can be cast once to create a normal copy of a nearby herb. Irradiated herbs have a violet circle around them.

The Ironpaws are an influential family of pandaren associated with the Cooking profession at Halfhill Market. The Ironpaw Token, named after the family, is a significant currency for cooking goods at Halfhill.

Admiral Janet Kaitway was a sailor during the Second War. Ravaged by dragonfire and thrown far off course during the conflict, Admiral Kaitway's ship returned home seven years later carrying a wealth of treasures from the South Seas. She donated much of her fortune to the Old Monastery in Lordaeron and served as archivist there until wanderlust called her to the Kalimdor Expedition. She eventually died at Theramore, now a paladin fighting against the orcs. Her training hammer was eventually retrieved and found its way back to the Scarlet Monastery in the Eastern Kingdoms.

Loa Speaker Jamanga once known as Mixer Jamanga, is a Witherbark alchemist once hailing from the Hinterlands branch of the Witherbark tribe and living in Shadra'Alor. After helping Nija Torntusk recover all three of the relics and resurrect Shadra, he was granted the honor of becoming the loa speaker of Shadra in the Witherbark tribe. The same honor was also extended to Nija, however she declined.

Jeremiah Pall is a Forsaken. In life, he was a human who had been drafted to serve as a foot soldier in Captain Whitney's division. Whitney was a cruel man who punished his men harshly for the slightest fault and forced them to sing his praise. Jeremiah once spent days locked in a dark box, no larger than a coffin, as punishment for insubordination. One night, a drunk Whitney stumbled onto a catapult and accidentally launched himself into an orcish camp, starting a fire in the process. The orcs, believing they were being attacked, retaliated against Jeremiah's division. Many people on both sides died in the battle but the humans eventually won and found their captain hiding in the orcs' camp
